groups.name: runtime
groups.description: Runtime execution tools exposed through the vulcan-runtime skill.

tools.name: vulcan-lua-help
tools.description: Show the current vulcan-runtime manual, available runtime APIs, installed Lua packages, output rules, and execution constraints.
tools.prompt: Use this tool before calling `vulcan-lua-exec` or `vulcan-lua-file` whenever you need the latest runtime manual, supported Lua package list, return rules, timeout rules, or disabled capability notes.

tools.name: vulcan-lua-exec
tools.description: Execute short ad-hoc Lua runtime code for loops, one-off file generation, lightweight network or command orchestration, and data transformation. Before execution, call `vulcan-lua-help` to read the current runtime manual and supported package list.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Optional human-readable task summary shown in the execution result header.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Lua source code executed inside the isolated luaexec runtime VM.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Optional structured arguments exposed to the script as the local variable `args`.

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Optional execution timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.

tools.prompt: Use this tool when you need quick ad-hoc Lua execution such as loops, one-off data processing, temporary file generation, regex handling, network probing, or command orchestration. You must call `vulcan-lua-help` first to read the current runtime manual, supported Lua libraries, return rules, and timeout guidance. This tool executes through vulcan.luaexec, captures `print(...)`, converts table returns into formatted JSON text, enforces a default 60000ms timeout unless timeout_ms is provided, and always returns a Markdown string.

tools.name: vulcan-lua-file
tools.description: Execute an existing Lua script file with cwd automatically switched to that file's directory. Before execution, call `vulcan-lua-help` to read the current runtime manual and supported package list.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Optional human-readable task summary shown in the execution result header.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Lua file path executed inside the isolated luaexec runtime VM. During execution the cwd automatically switches to the file directory.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Optional structured arguments exposed to the script as the local variable `args`.

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Optional execution timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.

tools.prompt: Use this tool when you already have a Lua script file and want it executed directly, especially when the script needs file-relative paths or multi-step logic that is clearer in a standalone file. You must call `vulcan-lua-help` first to read the current runtime manual, supported Lua libraries, return rules, and timeout guidance. This tool executes through vulcan.luaexec, automatically switches cwd to the file directory, captures `print(...)`, converts table returns into formatted JSON text, enforces a default 60000ms timeout unless timeout_ms is provided, and always returns a Markdown string.
